--- file:///.src/schemas.ts ---
import { Schema } from "effect"

export const Circle = Schema.Struct({ kind: Schema.Literal("circle"), radius: Schema.Finite })
export const Square = Schema.Struct({ kind: Schema.Literal("square"), side: Schema.Number })
export const Shape = Schema.Union([Circle, Square])

=== [D2] Fix 2: "Replace with Schema.Finite" ===

--- file:///.src/schemas.ts ---
import { Schema } from "effect"

export const Circle = Schema.Struct({ kind: Schema.Literal("circle"), radius: Schema.Number })
export const Square = Schema.Struct({ kind: Schema.Literal("square"), side: Schema.Finite })
export const Shape = Schema.Union([Circle, Square])
